notes.title: What should I do if there is a problem with game networking? Look here!
notes.content:
[i][b][h1]Question 1: What do I want to do with online battles[/h1][/b][/i]

[b][h3]Why can't you connect to the room? It's easy to fall out when entering the room?[/h3][/b]

Due to insufficient funds to purchase servers, we can only use Steam's P2P online service^<
Please do not complain about "server junk". The game does not have a server, and the quality of the network depends on the communication between the homeowner and Steam.
"Moe Pet Dismantling Music" supports online connection, but the underlying network technology uses Steam's P2P service;
Network stability depends on the Steam network and the landlord's network environment;
Simply put, the homeowner acts as a forwarding server to forward messages, while Steam assists in the entire process.
In this case, poor local Steam network or poor homeowner network can lead to disconnection and disconnection.

[b][h3]How can the network be more stable?[/h3][/b]

At present, the first known method is the use of accelerators, and the official has collaborated with some accelerators to improve network conditions to a certain extent;
However, players also said that the accelerator is not used, but rather too laggy. This is recommended for everyone to try. If it is not used, it will be OK;
If you are too laggy, try the accelerator. If you still haven't solved the problem, you can give feedback in the Discard group.

[b][h3]Welcome to share your insights[/h3][/b]

(*｀∀´*)ノ亻!If you have internet skills, please let us know or our group members quickly! Meow, meow, thank you so much~


[b][i][h1]Question 2: I want to collaborate on home demolitions in online storyline mode[/h1][/i][/b]

[b][h3]Using steam remote music sharing[/h3][/b]

1. Click on the console to start the game, and "Moe Pet Dismantling and Dismantling Music" will start!

2. When the console is running the game, open the friend interface, click "Invite anyone to join the game", and open Steam to play remotely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/533bd6a6e03e33ad99a1b468ba10fe40a91a4b0f.png[/img]

3. Click on "Invite Friends" or "Invite Visitors" on the host to generate a link and invite players to join the game "Moe Pet Demolition Music".

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/ba1006164181ff04f3fe2a772414544f8d091e1a.jpg[/img]

4. Click on the icon [keyboard] and [mouse] on the host to unlock the corresponding operation permissions of the player.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/14e913bc77f7b0761247701a735079860ab0820f.png[/img]

5. If the accelerator is stuck and turned on, accelerate remote music sharing

[b][h3]Using third-party online software[/h3][/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44551396/4dee2b02388051ae12815d141289c4b90221c105.jpg[/img]

[b][h3]I also want to connect to the internet instead of split screen[/h3][/b]

Due to initial technical architecture issues, we are currently unable to achieve this, and we are still trying our best!

notes.title: Hello, dear players (Θ３Θ), we've rolled out an update.
notes.content:
Hello, fellow players (Θ３Θ)! We've swiftly conducted an update based on the reported BUGs.

New levels, UI updates, improved beginner tutorials, localization additions (partial), bug fixes


[list]
[*] - Added local PvP mode, where you can experience asymmetrical battles between the owner and pets (✪ω✪)
[*] - Supports remote music sharing, it is recommended to turn on the accelerator to avoid network fluctuations
[*] - Optimized beginner tutorial prompts and game flow
[*] - Added scenes outside the room
[*] - Enhanced level art
[*] - Adjusted in-game UI
[*] - Fixed bugs such as the host opening the map, game freeze on completion, and map pathfinding baking
[/list]

The trial version of the storyline mode covers approximately 15% of the current content, while the full storyline mode takes about 5-8 hours. Online and home modes will only be available in the full version.

[b]Please note that the newly added local PvP is in the testing phase, and various functions are not yet perfect, such as scoring and balance... 
QAQ The save data will be cleared when the official version is launched!!! (Due to active adjustments based on player feedback by the studio staff, the levels in the demo version may not represent the final version, and save data cannot be used after the official version is launched.)[/b]

Momo has already achieved the crowdfunding goal of 20,000. Thanks so much for your support! The emojis you've been waiting for are in a new folder! Additional rewards for different tiers are being unlocked, so for those still considering, please lend your support! (｀0´)

Limited edition physical merchandise for "Cute Pet Dismantle Fun" is currently on presale, with some custom slots still available.
Momo crowdfunding: https://zhongchou.modian.com/item/130091.html

Feel free to join our player Q group 913264119 for discussions!
